annotations.title: Code of conduct generator with coverage check

description: Code of conduct generator with coverage check — Write an original code of conduct in markdown for a community, open-source project, event or workplace, then check offline for the standard sections (purpose/scope, expected and unacceptable behavior, reporting, confidentiality and no retaliation, enforcement, contact), a real reporting contact and on-site help for events; returns sections, coverage, score and issues. Params: org (required), type (community|open-source|event|workplace), contact, values. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_code_of_conduct
